visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large orange and white domestic cat sits on a patterned round mat atop a dark wooden table. A much smaller black and white kitten stands beside it, sniffing the mat's surface. The background consists of a dark-toned living area with shelves holding bottles and various household decorations. (2) The orange cat raises its white right paw and delicately taps the kitten's forehead twice. The kitten looks up, maintaining its position while the older cat watches it intently. The camera is positioned at eye-level, capturing the cats in a medium shot against the indoor backdrop. (3) The orange cat leans forward to thoroughly sniff the kitten's back and tail area. The kitten remains still on the mat, and the lighting is warm and consistent across the indoor scene. Several variety text overlays appear in the upper and middle portions of the frame. (4) The orange cat suddenly pulls its head back and raises its paw again, looking away as if reacting to a smell. The scene uses fast cuts to show different angles of this reaction. The kitten looks slightly confused as the older cat keeps its distance on the table. (5) The kitten begins to jump and playfully bat at the orange cat's face and chest. The two engage in a brief, low-intensity sparring match on the table surface. Comic-style graphic overlays like yellow stars and impact lines appear around the cats to emphasize the playfulness of the fight.
